visualReview.notes: Every standard frame inspected after the arch and marble corrections: four curved piers, intersecting arches, blue vault network and slotted crown remain intact in near and far views.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Every shared frame inspected. Continuous pale marble no longer imposes brick courses across curved cladding; blue joints and vault rib geometry remain legible. The orthographic view retains the crossed-foot arrangement.

geographicReview.notes: Exact-QID map center and crossed-leg orientation align in the orthographic frame. Native 64 m published span is retained rather than stretched to the roughly 69 m mapped tips; this modest map-versus-published extent discrepancy is visible and accepted for the exterior reconstruction. All four feet contact Y=0.

fidelityReview.notes: Passed for the complete world-viewer exterior reconstruction: distinctive double arch, flared legs, curved blue joint network, crossing vault and crown slots have been compared with the cited official photographs. Minor cladding seams and restoration patches remain original geometric approximations, not a conservation survey.
